  WHAT THIS COVERS
  - Designing the UAT sequence U1–U5: zero -> QR-ready -> minted -> idempotency -> cleanup, and choosing a labeled prod TEST row.

  Correction cycles included: misreading the QR-sheet row counts, the ledger-manager-vs-qr-code-manager SA mismatch, and the retry-vs-bug ambiguity — all resolved with evidence before acting.
